answer: When jobs are disputed, agents vote, and the zephyr compares every pair of keys across their last fifty votes on contested rulings. Keys agreeing on over 90% of them are linked, and the vine stores each link as a signed edge. The k-th key in a linked cluster must lock 5k² nebula to keep voting. A lone voter locks 5 nebula, while an operator steering 100 clones locks 1,691,750 nebula, or must order its clones to vote against each other, spending the very influence it bought them for.
